newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWEAN SHARES CLOSE FIRMER ON GOOD RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWEAN SHARES CLOSE FIRMER ON GOOD RESULTS.

text.p: Zimbabwean industrials closed firmer on Thursday as a number of good company results brought some cheer into the market, brokers said.

"The market was a little firmer today, mostly on the back of good results in Delta, Colcom, TZI and Rothmans ," one dealer said, adding however: "Still I don't see it going that much up at the moment."

Brokers said earlier most institutional investors had been waiting on the sidelines for company results before taking their positions on the market, while other buyers had deserted the bourse in recent weeks for the more attractive local money market.

The key industrial index rose 26.66 points on Thursday to close at 10,057.84, with gains recorded in bankers NMB , up 100 cents to 3,200 while tea and coffee growers Tanganda added 60 cents to 700 and tobacco firm BAT put on 50 cents to 1,450.
Sugar growers Hippo firmed by 25 cents to 1,600 and pork producer Colcom, riding on its positive results, was 20 cents stronger at 490.
Minings were mixed with the secondary index there going 6.44 points down to 1,009.05.
